avis.titre: Great Firming/Hydrating Retinal especially for Beginners
avis.texte: I really enjoyed [and highly recommend esp for beginners] this Retinal ReSculpt Overnight Treatment that I was sent by @muradskincare & @influenster despite not getting particularly dramatic results, or expecting to- and I'll tell you why. . Understanding the difference in Retinol & Retinal-- basically they are Vitamin A derivatives -- each removed a step further from Vit A (rx Tretinoin) itself. So Tretinoin needs no conversion into Vit A in your skin, Retinal converts one time, so it is the next most potent, then Retinol needs to convert twice-- once to retinal, then again into Vit A. I am an experienced Tretinoin user who has used many many retinols/retinals in the past- so I did not expect dramatic results with this cream. What I was looking for when I quit using my Tret after I was told this was coming in the mail, hoping to allow some texture to return that always does when I go off it (wykyk) ---what I hoped to see was this--would this cream help with firming, [as it claims] brightening, texture, fine lines --at all? I did not expect miracles. But I was pleasantly surprised with the way this treatment immediately feels on skin. . I feel like it would be okay even for sensitive skin, but mine is not so I'd have to defer on that one. Things I noticed on first use- a smooth creamy feeling, brightening, softening, nice gentle scent, hydrating, and indeed firming--I never had a problem through the entire usage with this treatment drying my skin. Which is great with retinal

avis.texte: As an mua and Skin Care Specialist (that often compunds products for my own clients,) if I'm asked to try a product, or it's caught my attention as far as claims, studies, ingredients, etc…I'll always try it for them(my clients.). Although I knew the ingredients were there and proper clinical studies / proper chemical testing; I'll admit, still I was apprehensive if this beauty could live up to the claims. The brand offered to send it to me, but I declined, usually if it's something expensive…I want to see it from a specialist's and consumers view point. So this like many, I purchased. Pros, very cream like. This is a good thing because it really STAYS and works through the skin while you sleep. No fragrance can be detected (and usually I'm the first to smell it lol) although with any product meant to" change the skin" and take old, layers…I always recommend anyone (regardless of what you have used in the past), to patch test one or two nights, and "tip your toes in the water/serum" spacing it out. Also moisture! Your skin will need moisture even if you have oily skin. SPF is needed also. Still, this has been extremely gentle on only myself, but my employees and those testing with me. In my studios I do different "computerized map testing" as to know it's truly working and not just a "I want it to work, situation" 12 out of 15 showed DRASTIC improvements in fine lines and even deep wrinkles. 13-15 showed a brighter complexion and less age/sun spots.
